name: Health Sync for Home Assistant
description: Simple App Store screenshots: one app screen and five text panels.

elements.name: body
elements.content: The app reads Apple Health on your iPhone and sends the readings to a webhook in your Home Assistant. There is no account and no service in the middle.

elements.name: footer
elements.content: HEALTH SYNC · APPLE HEALTH → HOME ASSISTANT

elements.name: body
elements.content: Health Sync does not relay data through a cloud. The phone has to be able to open the webhook URL itself: the same Wi-Fi, a VPN such as Tailscale, or a remote address such as Nabu Casa. If the phone cannot reach that address, the sync fails.

elements.name: footer
elements.content: HEALTH SYNC · APPLE HEALTH → HOME ASSISTANT

elements.name: body
elements.content:
1. Install HACS in Home Assistant.
2. HACS → Integrations → ⋯ → Custom repositories.
3. Add github.com/thebillington/health-assist as an Integration.
4. Install Health Sync and restart Home Assistant.
5. Settings → Devices & services → Add integration → Health Sync.

elements.name: footer
elements.content: HEALTH SYNC · APPLE HEALTH → HOME ASSISTANT

elements.name: body
elements.content: Steps, sleep, heart rate, weight and other readings become Home Assistant sensors. The first sync sends all available history; later syncs send new data. Sensors have stable IDs and units, and history is added to long-term statistics.

elements.name: footer
elements.content: HEALTH SYNC · APPLE HEALTH → HOME ASSISTANT

elements.name: body
elements.content: The app and the Home Assistant integration are free and MIT licensed. There is no account, no analytics, no paid tier and no in-app purchase. If you want to support my work, click the Support Me button in the app.

elements.content: HEALTH SYNC · APPLE HEALTH → HOME ASSISTANT
